report.explanation: Current evidence contradicts the operator hypothesis: gateway checkout traces are OK (72ms), order logs show 200/ok, order error_rate 0.001 with p95 80ms, and no dependency timeouts. The order deployment (3.3.9, ~2583 min old) is only a version fact, not proof of causation. No checkout failures are observed, so no bounded root cause can be established; handing off for evidence of actual failures.
